notes.title: Patch Alpha 2.5
notes.content:
Hi  and happy end of summer vacations folks,

This time I'm announcing an update allowing you to see a summary of your empire under economic point of view.

I'm sorry to not update this game regularly but I've underestimated time and energy consumed by my job. I'm sorry for that small update after seven month of silence. In order to accelerate developpement, I'll focus on more critical and easier features.

[u]Patchnote :[/u]

[list]
[*] Added an economic menu.
[/list]

tags.feature: Added an economic menu.

notes.title: Patch Alpha 2.4.4
notes.content:
Hi  and happy new year (three weeks late) folks,

Today I'm announcing an update allowing you to see a summary of the opinion of the population of each planet in a dedicated screen.

I also announce that I found a full-time job this month, which will slow down the development of the game due to lack of time. My apologies for the inconvenience.

[u]Patchnote :[/u]

[list]
[*] Added a population screen in the empire menu..
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Alpha 2.4.2
notes.content:
Hi folks,

It's been a while since the last patch note and it's time to talk about what was going on behind the scenes. Besides the school holidays and the personal life to manage, I had to work on an element of the game which has just taken a lot of importance (surely too much besides ...), the policy.

Initially this was to be a game only geared towards the strategic aspect with a bit of management, now there is a menu (pictured below) focusing on policy issues with the option of making your own Constitution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41204140/9effa09bdc5797174006762b38257d0bd92cf1ce.png[/img]

It was both frustrating and backbreaking work, less at the implementation level but more at the theorizing level of the system in the end. At the moment, only the Constitution component is available and the sequel should arrive thereafter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41204140/9a3e00f240aec7ce9da94b58fb34cf073deefbd1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41204140/b82163a2e05e423f2b3de4c8d7368133d530ef5c.png[/img]

Moreover each possible decision in the Constitution has an effect on your political alignment which is illustrated by the small box below. This is for the moment only a temporary display while waiting for the final model to be ready (for the moment there are still some problems of scale above). I would detail all of what alignment means once display is complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41204140/ea86289f43fa9433e729a5d177126de6d1eaad37.png[/img]


[u]Patchnote :[/u]

[list]
[*] Adding empire menu ;
[*] Added Constitution tab to empire menu.
[/list]

Added Constitution tab to empire menu.

notes.title: Patch Alpha 2.3.2

tags.feature: Buildings now provide jobs
Mass unemployment is now lowering stability
Lack of food also lowers stability now

tags.balance_change: The income of the empire depends on the number of employees henceforth, the unemployed bring nothing

tags.feature: Production is affected by employment now
Addition of a manpower indicator in the planets interface
Addition of an indicator of jobs required for buildings
Modification of the behavior of the space dedicated to the effects on stability in the tooltips

notes.title: Patch Alpha 2.2.2

tags.feature: Added a stability bar to the interface;
Addition of an indication detailing what affects the stability;
The population is no longer capped by the available dwellings. You can be homeless now;
The population can now overconsume food leading to shortages and famines;
A research laboratory has been added for initial colonization;
Population growth is now affected by overpopulation;
Overcrowding negatively affects stability in proportion to the number of homeless people;

tags.balance_change: The population growth has been reduced by a factor of 1.5 to 1.1 in normal times and 1.01 in the event of overpopulation;
Population retention in famine has been increased from 0.75 to 0.95.

notes.title: Patch Alpha 2.1.0

tags.feature: Addition of description panels;
Addition of icons for civil, space and military productions;

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where it was not possible to select a star near the top of the main interface;

tags.balance_change: The refinery consumes 2 energies instead of producing 1 now;
Civilian production in civil industry has increased from 100 to 10.
